widths.note: printed 83' near Sycamore; the north face slants, so the street widens eastward

bends.note: alley narrows from 20' to about 14' here; its centreline steps from about y 1700 (west) to about y 1680 (east)

notes: Main on the west, Sycamore on the east, E. 3rd at the top, E. 2nd at the bottom. Hammond (printed HAMMOND, about 41 ft between faces, no width printed) comes in from the north (sheet 117) and ends at E. 3rd. Hopple Alley (printed HOPPLE ALLEY) runs from Main to Sycamore and ends at both. Produce Alley (printed PRODUCE ALLEY, 10') runs from E. 2nd (continuing south on sheet 103) north to E. Pearl; its last 150 ft or so at the Pearl end passes under a building as a covered drive (printed DRIVE), so it is recorded as reaching Pearl (T). Main shifts about 13 px east south of 2nd (the south-side corners are offset), so Main/2nd is the average. E. Pearl is much wider here than west of Main (73-83 ft against 50 ft on sheet 112); its centre is taken midway between the drawn block faces. The large numerals 1 and 2 printed in the alleys are not widths.
